title: Clarify improves AI answers by comparing ChatGPT, Claude, and #clarifyai #aisafety #legaltech
description: Clarify uses AI consensus to improve decision accuracy by querying ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini simultaneously. It helps professionals identify when AI answers align and when skepticism is needed, reducing risks in high-stakes legal, business, and career decisions. Traditional reliance on a single language model can lead to errors 50-80% of the time, with AI often appearing confident even when wrong. Clarify’s approach highlights discrepancies between models, providing a consensus score that signals when answers are reliable or deserve caution. This method enhances trust and transparency in AI-assisted decision-making, offering a practical tool for professionals who require precision and validation before acting on AI-generated advice. #ClarifyAI #ChatGPT #ClaudeAI #GeminiAI #AIDecisionMaking #LegalTech #BusinessAI #AIVerification #AIConsensus #AIConfidence #ProfessionalAI #RiskManagement #HighStakesAI #AIAccuracy #AIEthics
